lines.zh: 我八条腿一起动，走得很稳
lines.en: All eight legs move together, steady

lines.zh: 我这么大，走过的路都要绕一下
lines.en: Being this large, the ground bends around my path

lines.zh: 身上的管子互相碰，响得难听
lines.en: The tubes on me knock together, an ugly sound
I crawl between the end islands

lines.zh: 身子很宽，转身要用很久
lines.en: I am broad, turning takes a long while

lines.zh: 我一步一步，地面往下沉
lines.en: Step by step, the ground sinks

lines.zh: 我身上有一条线，一直在亮
lines.en: A line on me keeps glowing

lines.zh: 我穿过林子，树都被挤开了
lines.en: I cross the forest and the trees are pushed apart
Slow, and I need no speed

lines.zh: 我抬头，看我身上那些管子
lines.en: I look up at the tubes on my body
My legs sink into the soil
When I walk, the air hums

lines.zh: 我伏在那儿，像一堆废铁
lines.en: I crouch there like a heap of scrap
The lines on my body pulse

lines.zh: 我不动，土地还在我的重量下
lines.en: Still as I am, the ground holds my weight

lines.zh: 这里的空气有一点金属味
lines.en: There is a metallic taste in the air

lines.zh: 我缓慢地转头，看向一边
lines.en: I turn my head slowly to one side
With this body, I cannot hide
I wait, I am patient

lines.zh: 背上的管子还在轻轻响
lines.en: The tubes on my back still hum softly
This whole stretch is flattened by me
Most of the time I do not move
I listen for what comes

lines.zh: 我身上的机关又转过一格
lines.en: A gear in me has clicked one notch

lines.zh: 我的腿太长，站着也要用力
lines.en: My legs are long, even standing takes effort
You are in front of me, a small point

lines.zh: 我低下头，脖子上的管子吊着
lines.en: I lower my head, the tubes hanging from my neck
You are not what I expected

lines.zh: 我这一身，是做出来用的
lines.en: This body of mine was built for use
Do not be afraid, I am in no hurry
My gaze settles on your shoulder

lines.zh: 你能走到这儿，也有些本事
lines.en: Reaching here took some ability
Everything here can be taken apart

lines.zh: 你的重量，对我来说不算什么
lines.en: Your weight means nothing to me
When I move, the soil turns
Stop and stay still

lines.zh: 我低头，看着你脚边的地
lines.en: I lower my head and look at the ground by your feet

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候，我正看着你
lines.en: When you looked up, I was already watching
What you have to say, I will hear slowly
A hole in my shell
I step back and the ground rings
One tube has broken
I lower my head to save the strain

lines.zh: 我不觉得疼，只是缺了一块
lines.en: I do not hurt, only miss a piece
One of my legs failed to take the load
This frame of mine is still standing
You have more strength than I thought
I have stored that one
Is that scrap in your hand

lines.zh: 我吃的东西，和这不一样
lines.en: What I eat is not that

lines.zh: 一点点，连我的管子都填不满
lines.en: That much would not fill one of my tubes
Giving it to me does nothing
It is something else I want
Leave it on the ground, I will eat later
This can be pulled apart
My shell is packed with scrap.

lines.zh: 这东西在手里，不如在地上
lines.en: That belongs on the ground, not in a hand
I am not picky, and I eat a great deal

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞柱子
lines.en: You struck my leg like a pillar

lines.zh: 这一下，我的管子折了一根
lines.en: That bent one of my tubes

lines.zh: 别贴着我，我身上都是硬壳
lines.en: Do not press close, I am all hard shell
You stepped back, the soil turned over
My weight is greater than you think
You are standing in my shadow

lines.zh: 这一碰，你身上有东西响了
lines.en: At that contact, something in you sounded
Touch again and I come down
That I could not say

lines.zh: 我是完全体，和我不一样
lines.en: I am a perfect level, and I am not like you
I am the only one here on the end islands

lines.zh: 你看我的样子，会想别的
lines.en: Looking at me, you will think of other things

lines.zh: 我的管子没有那种用途
lines.en: These tubes are not for that
I have never thought about it
Stand if you will, but say nothing

lines.zh: 我要的是一块安静的地方
lines.en: What I want is a quiet patch of ground
You are too small
I turn away slowly

lines.zh: 我伸出前腿，把它按住了
lines.en: I put a foreleg out and pin it
I can eat any scrap here
I pinch it up and drop it in my mouth
Not enough, far too little
That mouthful had no taste at all
I took it apart
Empty inside, no parts at all
I spit the parts out
It fell, I ignored it
You want it too? Take it
I heard them, your steps

lines.zh: 我慢慢站起来，地都在动
lines.en: I rise slowly and the ground moves
This stretch is mine now
You are lined up with my center

lines.zh: 我的管子里开始有声音
lines.en: My tubes begin to sound
Whichever way you go is empty

lines.zh: 我这体型，挡得住一整条路
lines.en: A body this size blocks a whole road

lines.zh: 我动一次，就要很久才停
lines.en: Once I move, I take long to stop

lines.zh: 这一带没有能挡的东西
lines.en: There is nothing here to block me
I do not shout, I bear down
I follow you, the ground rings

lines.zh: 你跑得很快，可路是死的
lines.en: You run fast, and the road is dead
One turn of mine breaks the trees
You cannot outrun me in this stretch
One of my steps is ten of yours

lines.zh: 我把腿伸出去，路就没了
lines.en: I stretch a leg out and the road is gone
Your prints are under my feet
The glow on me is closing on you
Do you hear the tubes
There is no second path here
This body does not know weariness
A little closer is enough
My foreleg comes down
That collapsed a patch of ground
One charge and you are in the wall
My tubes whip across you
The sweep took your footing
That was heavy, I heard it
I bear down, my shadow arriving first
Your armor is screaming
I give a little and press again
After that, your legs are shaking
I missed clean, and it was still heavy
The next will land center

lines.zh: 末地的空地上多了一个大影子
lines.en: A great shadow has come to the end's open ground
I climb up over the island's edge
The ground is pressed down a layer
The tubes sound first
I rise, taller than the trees
My legs come down one by one
This stretch has me from today
The lines on me are lit
The air around me has grown heavy

lines.zh: 从末地石缝里，我撑起八条腿。
lines.en: From the End stone cracks I lift eight legs.
Everything on the island has gone still

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，土都溅起来
lines.en: When I landed, the soil sprayed up
Fire runs up along the tubes

lines.zh: 我从岛边掉下去，摔得很沉
lines.en: I fell from the island edge, heavily

lines.zh: 我这身子进了水，就动不了
lines.en: With this body in water, I cannot move

lines.zh: 炸得我身上的线全断了
lines.en: The blast broke every line on me
An arrow is stuck in a shell seam

lines.zh: 那股劲儿在我内部乱转
lines.en: That force turns wildly inside me

lines.zh: 废料吃完了，我的动力在降
lines.en: The scrap is gone, my power is falling

lines.zh: 雷落在我的管子上，全亮了
lines.en: Lightning hit my tubes and they all lit up

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我也在往下掉
lines.en: No ground here, and I am falling too
